category_rules.name: configuration-and-data
category_rules.reason: Configuration, generated inventories, lock metadata, and data fixtures are covered by the root LICENSE and do not share a safe inline-comment convention.

category_rules.name: documentation
category_rules.reason: Repository documentation is covered by the root LICENSE without repeated inline notices.

category_rules.name: lock-data
category_rules.reason: Generated dependency lock data is covered by the root LICENSE and is not hand-authored source.

category_rules.name: package-markers
category_rules.reason: Empty package marker files have no content in which to place a notice and are covered by the root LICENSE.

category_rules.name: repository-control-files
category_rules.reason: Repository control files without a uniform extension or safe notice syntax are covered by the root LICENSE.

category_rules.name: web-markup
category_rules.reason: Web templates and markup are covered by the root LICENSE without injecting visible or framework-specific comments.
